professionalSummary.text: Prepares underwriting assessments for approximately 700 applications annually against lending policy under the assessment procedure.
professionalSummary.witness: Mortgage underwriting analyst in a retail bank's residential lending team for three years, preparing the underwriting assessments for about seven hundred applications a year against the lending policy under the assessment procedure.

professionalSummary.text: Verifies income and property documents on each application using the verification standard with completed verification checklists.
professionalSummary.witness: Verified the income and property documents on each application under the verification standard, with the verification checklist completed on each case file.

professionalSummary.text: Explains declined or conditioned outcomes to mortgage advisers on the adviser line with escalations logged, including 11 escalations over three years, none upheld against the assessment.
professionalSummary.witness: Explained the declined and conditioned outcomes to the mortgage advisers on the adviser line, with the adviser escalations logged; eleven escalations in three years, none upheld against the assessment.

professionalSummary.text: Refers cases outside policy or above mandate to the senior underwriter, recording referral reasons and mandate on each case.
professionalSummary.witness: Referred the cases outside policy or above my mandate to the senior underwriter, recording the referral reason and the mandate on each case.

professionalSummary.text: Documents open items and hand-over conditions on each case passed to another analyst or senior underwriter.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions on each case passed to another analyst or to the senior underwriter.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Two anonymised case files including assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record, and adviser escalation log extract with underwriting system references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two anonymised case files (assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record) and the adviser escalation log extract, with the underwriting system references as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in preparing assessments, verifying documents, explaining outcomes, referring cases, and documenting open items, but do not establish the candidate's direct interaction with the valuation panel or senior underwriters beyond referrals.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess the candidate's ability to explain declined outcomes to advisers who push back, as the materials do not establish the candidate's ability to handle pushback beyond the logged escalations.

evidence.text: Mortgage underwriting analyst in a retail bank's residential lending team for three years, preparing the underwriting assessments for about seven hundred applications a year against the lending policy under the assessment procedure.
Verified the income and property documents on each application under the verification standard, with the verification checklist completed on each case file.

Explained the declined and conditioned outcomes to the mortgage advisers on the adviser line, with the adviser escalations logged; eleven escalations in three years, none upheld against the assessment.
Referred the cases outside policy or above my mandate to the senior underwriter, recording the referral reason and the mandate on each case.
Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions on each case passed to another analyst or to the senior underwriter.
